# 111 — Analytics nav + filter-dropdown UI polish. HIGH-tier explainer

**Item:** 111 · Analytics-app nav de-noise + open-filter-dropdown state polish (human feedback 2026-07-15 on 093's shipped nav: "the data and icons are very confusing, needs an upgrade"; "these selectors need better hover overlay controls and UI for [the open-dropdown] state"). Human chose option 1: strip category-tab icons, keep filter icons.
**Verifier:** attempt-1 FAIL (2 blockers: missing this file; an unscoped shared-CSS-rule change) → both fixed → re-verify. 9/9 functional criteria independently re-derived PASS on attempt 1.
**Risk:** HIGH — touches the analytics render path (nav-rail DOM, outside-click interaction, new scrim). NOT on the NEVER list: no trust-rail weakening (`APY_SANITY_LIMIT`/`DEFAULT_MIN_TVL`/anomaly/haircut untouched — grep-empty on the diff), no `__APP_MODE` router change, no `?token=/?chain=/?pool=` behavior change, no deps/config beyond wiring the new test into `npm test`. Auto-merges under autonomy (c) after verifier PASS + tests green.

## Goal
The analytics app is the SEO arrival surface feeding the card funnel. The human called its nav "confusing" and the open-dropdown controls weak. Two clarity/trust fixes, no functional/data change: (A) de-noise the primary category rail, (B) make the open filter-dropdown state calmer and its selected state unmistakable, on the neumorphic system.

## Intuition
This is **presentation only** — zero change to what pools show, how they're filtered, or any number. (A) removes competing glyphs from text-labeled category tabs. (B) removes a CLAUDE.md-banned scale-pop, makes the selected chip read as filled-primary, and adds a scrim + a *correct* outside-close (the old one was coincidental). The one subtlety is the scrim's stacking: it must dim the results without stealing clicks from the filter buttons, or filter-to-filter switching breaks.

## What changed and why (diff in reading order)

### app.js
1. **Category tabs → text-only (~L2810).** Removed the single `navIcon(icon),` line from the `.google-nav-primary` `CATEGORY_TABS.map(...)`. The 6 glyphs competed with plain labels ("Lending"/"Staking"/…). `NAV_ICONS`, `navIcon`, and `CATEGORY_TABS`' `icon` field are left intact — the 4 filter buttons still call `navIcon()`, so nothing else moves.
2. **Outside-click handler tightened (~L1255).** Old condition tested `!event.target.closest('.filter-dropdown-container')` — a class that **does not exist** in this nav (dropdowns are `.global-filter-dropdown`, rendered at document top level), so it closed on essentially *any* click and only "worked" because pills self-close. Replaced with: close unless the click is inside `.global-filter-dropdown` OR on a `.google-filter-btn`. Panel interaction and direct filter-to-filter switching no longer misfire.
3. **Scrim element (~L3270).** Rendered as a top-level sibling of the global dropdowns, only when `activeDropdown` is truthy: `className:'global-filter-scrim'`, `onClick: () => setActiveDropdown(null)`, `aria-hidden`. It's the visible dim + the explicit outside-close surface.

### style.css
4. **Removed the CLAUDE.md-BANNED scale-pop hover (~L1329).** `.global-filter-dropdown .filter-pill:hover:not(.active), .filter-chip:hover:not(.active)` went from `transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02)` → `transform: translateY(-1px)` (neuro lift only, box-shadow retained). No `scale()` remains on this selector (`grep "scale(1.02)" style.css` → only 3 unrelated pre-existing hits: pool-card hero, `.logo:hover`, `yieldBounce`; correctly left alone as out-of-scope).
5. **Unmistakable filled-primary selected CHIP (~L1383) — scoped.** The shared `.filter-pill.active, .filter-chip.active` rule keeps its **original** `translateY(-1px)/neuro-shadow-raised` (pills byte-unchanged). A **chip-only** rule after it carries the whole filled look: `background: var(--color-primary); color: white; font-weight: semibold; transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: subtle` — matching `.google-filter-btn.has-selection`. Scoped to `.filter-chip` so `.chain-pill.active` (brand `--chain-color`) and `.protocol-pill.active` keep their existing fill **and** lift. *(Attempt-1 put the transform/shadow change on the shared rule, altering pills too — the verifier flagged it; this is the corrected scoping.)*
6. **`.global-filter-scrim` block (~L1243).** `position:fixed; top:128px; left/right/bottom:0; z-index:99998; background:rgba(15,23,42,0.06)` light, `rgba(0,0,0,0.28)` dark. **`top:128px`** matches the dropdowns' hardcoded fixed `top` so the scrim starts *below* the sticky header (z-index 100) — filter buttons stay clickable, only the results area dims. z-index 99998 sits just under the dropdowns' 99999. `scrimFade` opacity keyframe; `prefers-reduced-motion` → no animation.

### tests / regen
7. **`test_nav_rail_ia.js`** — assertion #4 rewritten: category tabs have **NO** `<svg>`, every filter button has **exactly one**. `icons.llamao.fi` added to `IGNORABLE_ERROR_PATTERN` (external logo CDN, connection-reset in sandbox; same class as fontshare/mixpanel).
8. **`test_filter_dropdown_polish.js`** (NEW, rendered Playwright, 7 assertions) — drives the real UI at `/?token=USDC`: B1 scrim present on open; B2 selected chip filled-primary (non-transparent, differs from a non-active chip, white text); B3 hover has no scale (matrix m11===1); B4 scrim-click closes; B5 open/scrim/close survives 360/768/1280 + a dark-mode tint check; zero page errors. Wired into `npm test` (package.json).
9. **Regenerated** `app.compiled.js`, `app.compiled.min.js` (`npm run compile`), `style.min.css` (`npm run minify`). No translations touched (zero new strings).
